values.note: 2027 county fee sheet (approved 2026-09-08), the same for county residents and visitors: rustic sites $30 a night, $35 weekends and July; electric-only sites $35 / $40. Week $190 rustic / $240 electric, month $700 / $825, season $1,800 / $2,450. Every reservation (online, phone or in person) adds a 3% booking fee. A vehicle pass is required for every vehicle entering the park: $5 a day or $20 a season.

values.note: 35 sites with electricity and 17 rustic sites, plus one rustic cabin. One camping unit per site (an extra sleeping tent by approval and fee).

sites.source: https://www.missaukee.org/departments/parks/index.php (Crooked Lake Park: '35 campsites with electricity', '17 rustic campsites', '1 Rustic cabin') + https://www.missaukee.org/Park%20Rules%209-9-2025.pdf (rule 19), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Modern restrooms with showers; sanitation station with well water (free for registered campers, $10 otherwise); two hand-pump wells. Firewood sold at the host site.

facilities.source: https://www.missaukee.org/departments/parks/index.php (Crooked Lake Park: 'Sanitation station with well water', '2 hand pump water wells in Park', 'Modern restrooms w/showers') + https://www.missaukee.org/2027%20Crooked%20Park%20Fees.pdf ('DUMP STATION: FREE FOR REGISTERED CAMPERS ALL OTHERS: $10 PER USE'; 'FIREWOOD BUNDLES AVAILABLE FOR PURCHASE AT HOST SITE'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Book online on Campspot or call the park office, 231-295-1038 (May 15 - October 1), off-season 231-839-4200. 2027 reservations are open.

note: Missaukee County park on the south side of Crooked Lake (9400 W Crooked Lake Rd, Lake City), on 60-plus acres with a swimming beach, a paved boat ramp, marked hiking trails, a covered pavilion and a rustic cabin. No ATVs, UTVs or golf carts in the park. --Claude
summary: County parks page + 2027 fee sheet + park rules: rates $30-40 confirmed (2027; residents and visitors pay the same), 3% booking fee and $5/day vehicle pass (entrance new), 52 sites (confirmed: 35 electric, 17 rustic), electric-only (water/sewer false, new; 30 A kept), showers/flush toilets/well water/dump station (new beside the dump), booked on Campspot or by phone (url new), season May 15 - Oct 1 (closes 09-30 -> 10-01).
